contentPattern.summary: One item row per slide; each row has two cells: image | rich text. Leading rows with no image become the intro panel (heading + CTA button) shown beside the slides. When no row has an image the block renders as a text-only strip (control strip or tab bar).

cells: rich text: heading, optional paragraph, CTA link
rich text: eyebrow/category paragraph, heading, "Read more" link

reuseGuidance: Use for horizontally scrolling article/teaser card lists with an optional intro. Options: alt (brand color background hook), image-above-text / image-above-text-2 (stacked card, image on top; -2 is the tinted-background version), purple (text-only control strip), purple-2 (pill tab bar of links). For full-width hero slides use carousel-hero.
usageDescription: Blog/article teaser carousel: an intro panel with heading and "go to blog" button beside horizontally scrolling article cards (text overlaid on image by default, image above text for image-above-text options). Catalog also places the arrow/dot control strip (purple) and the brand tab bar (purple-2) here.
